Name: Babymigo
Description: Connects expectant mothers with healthcare professionals; provides expert-verified health information on pregnancy, parenting and childbirth via SMS, app and web. Over 200,000 users.

Name: HelpMum
Description: Pregnancy tracking and telehealth app providing antenatal care date reminders, immunization session reminders and vaccination schedules for newborn babies.

Name: Whispa Health
Description: Safe platform where young people can freely ask questions about sexual and reproductive health and access medical help from certified, youth-friendly experts without judgment.

Name: MOBicure
Description: Develops the Omomi App - a health and social platform for parents to track immunization status, manage child health, and connect with doctors and other parents.

Name: MyFlair
Description: Digital platform for women's wellness, beauty and lifestyle offering curated products and health resources for African women.

Name: Baby Diary
Description: Digital child health tracking app that helps parents monitor milestones, immunizations and developmental progress of their children.

Name: Mobihealth International
Description: Telehealth clinics offering remote consultations and access to specialist care including women's health services across Nigeria and beyond.

Name: GiftedMom
Description: SMS-based platform sending prenatal appointment reminders, vaccination schedules and maternal health tips to pregnant women and new mothers in underserved communities.

Name: Kasha
Description: E-commerce platform enabling women to buy health and personal care products (sanitary pads, contraceptives) with confidential delivery. Over 20,000 customers. Phone consultations on fertility and sexual health.

Name: Malaica
Description: Formerly MumsVillage. Reimagining maternity care through expert-led support with obstetricians, midwives and psychologists providing evidence-based care from antenatal to postnatal stages.

Name: Totohealth
Description: Uses simple mobile technology to deliver pregnancy and child health information through SMS, helping expectant mothers and parents of children under five receive timely guidance.

Name: Jacaranda Health
Description: Operates affordable maternity hospitals and PROMPTS - an SMS-based digital platform providing maternal health support and connecting mothers to care in Kenya.

Name: Penda Health
Description: Medical care chain with on-demand telehealth services focused on affordable primary healthcare. Acquired Grace Health to strengthen women's health digital offerings.

Name: Zuri Health
Description: SMS-based telehealth services reaching patients who lack internet access, offering remote doctor consultations including women's health services.

Name: YeneHealth
Description: Ethiopia's first femtech startup combining AI, data analytics and culturally sensitive design. Period and pregnancy tracking app with e-pharmacy, virtual consultations and health information library.

Name: Grace Health
Region: West Africa / East Africa / Southern Africa
Description: Digital women's health platform with automated health assistant 'Grace' monitoring sexual and reproductive well-being. Over 1.3 million registered users. Acquired by Penda Health.

Name: Susu Health
Description: Affordable subscription-based maternal and child health services including telemedicine, health education and access to essential medications.

Name: SafeHands
Description: Focuses on menstrual hygiene education and providing affordable sanitary products to girls and women in underserved communities in Ghana.

Name: Zoie Health
Description: Digital app for family planning, fertility and maternity care. Virtual consultations with practitioners including doulas, nurses, midwives, GPs and mental health professionals. Founded 2021.

Name: Uteroo
Description: Period tracking app helping women track their menstrual cycle and make informed health choices. Founded by Pabi Moloi to normalise conversations around menstrual and reproductive health.

Name: My Pregnancy Journey
Description: Pregnancy tracking app with over 13,000 organic downloads. Provides week-by-week pregnancy information and health tracking for South African mothers.

Name: Umbilically
Description: Digital platform supporting pregnant women through their maternal journey with local health resources and community features tailored for the South African context.

Name: DilenyTech
Description: Innovative digital tools for breast cancer screening and AI-powered imaging solutions facilitating early and accurate detection. Founded by Dr. Ahmed Ehab Mahmoud.

Name: Hera
Description: Digital health platform focused on women's wellness and reproductive health, providing health education and teleconsultation services in North Africa.

Name: Afrimom
Description: Provides access to emergency contraception, pre- and post-exposure ART medication. Connects pregnant women to approved local obstetricians and maternity clinics.

Name: MamaOpe
Description: Biomedical smart jacket designed as a non-invasive, wireless diagnostic tool to expedite pneumonia detection in children. Founded by Olivia Koburongo and Brian Turyabagye.

Name: Terrewode
Description: Provides treatment, rehabilitation and reintegration support for women suffering from obstetric fistula, using mobile technology to connect patients with surgical care.

Name: Wazazi Nipendeni
Description: Government-backed SMS service delivering safe motherhood information and reminders. Over 750,000 registrants receiving 50+ million text messages since 2012 launch.

Name: Mammy App
Description: Supports women through fertility, pregnancy and motherhood by combining education with access to services and products for every stage of the maternal journey.

Name: Hamilguide
Description: Tech-enabled pregnancy education and tracking platform providing culturally relevant pregnancy guidance and health monitoring for women in the MENA/Africa region.

Name: Aya Health
Description: Digital health platform focused on women's health services including reproductive health consultations, wellness tracking and health education for Southern African women.

Name: LifeBank
Description: Technology-driven platform for blood and medical product delivery, significantly reducing maternal mortality by ensuring hospitals have timely access to blood products.

Name: mDoc
Description: Digital health coaching platform providing personalized care for chronic conditions affecting women including diabetes, hypertension and maternal health support.

Name: Flerie Health
Description: Women's wellness platform offering health products and educational content focused on reproductive and general women's health in the South African market.

Name: Calla Health
Description: Women's health technology platform addressing reproductive health, period tracking and wellness education for women in Egypt and the broader MENA region.

Name: Medikea
Description: Digital health platform connecting women in the DRC to healthcare providers, maternal health resources and reproductive health information.

Name: CareClick
Description: On-demand healthcare platform providing doctor consultations, lab tests and pharmacy services with dedicated women's health packages.

Name: MDaaS Global
Description: Network of affordable diagnostic centers providing radiology, pathology and women's health screening services including cervical cancer and breast cancer screenings.

Name: mPharma
Description: Pharmacy benefits management platform managing prescription drug inventory and making medications (including contraceptives and maternal health drugs) more affordable.

Name: Kangpe
Description: Telehealth platform enabling patients to consult doctors via their phones, including women's health consultations on reproductive and maternal issues.

Name: Sisu Global Health
Description: Develops affordable medical devices for birth including the Hemafuse autotransfusion device that recycles a patient's own blood during surgery to combat postpartum hemorrhage.

Name: SafeDelivery
Description: Mobile app providing emergency obstetric and neonatal care training for birth attendants and midwives in low-resource settings across East Africa.

Name: Maternova
Description: Marketplace and accelerator for maternal and newborn health innovations, connecting African health innovators with global markets and resources.

Name: NalaHealth
Description: Digital health platform providing personalized women's health information, period tracking and wellness resources for Ethiopian women.

Name: Femhealth Africa
Description: Pan-African platform supporting the femtech ecosystem through research, community building, investment facilitation and advocacy for women's health innovation.
